title: Neo Exponential Power
description: Let’s harness the power of exponentially growing energy
body:
This is a fork of https://modrinth.com/mod/exponential-power version 1.21.1

The EnderGenerator generates 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 RF/t
The AdvancedEnderGenerator generates 1.79e308 RF/t

Power generation will begin once you place EnderCell.

EnderStorage and AdvancedEnderStorage can store the same amount of energy as EnderGenerator and AdvancedEnderGenerator generate.

 

This text was translated using DeepL
